# TaxEase

> TaxEase is a tax and professional-services platform for web and Android
> (iOS is not currently offered). It bundles a 50-tool directory of free,
> browser-based tax and finance calculators — 37 hosted in TaxEase and 13 on
> the sibling site ZTools (https://ztools.zaions.com) — plus legal/business
> document generators and a service-request workflow for professional-services
> firms (intake, document handling, messaging, status tracking).
> All calculators run client-side and are for informational purposes only —
> not tax, legal, or financial advice. Built by Ahsan Mahmood.

## Tools (client-side, free)
- Tools overview: https://taxease-docs.aoneahsan.com/tools/overview
- Tax calculators (income, refund, 1099, payroll, quarterly, self-employment, capital gains, estate, social security, medicare, property, sales, bonus, crypto, W-4): https://taxease-docs.aoneahsan.com/tools/tax-calculators
- Personal finance (mortgage, loan, auto loan, compound interest, retirement, savings goal, budget, debt payoff, credit-card payoff, net worth): https://taxease-docs.aoneahsan.com/tools/personal-finance
- Business calculators (break-even, business loan, ROI, profit margin, cash flow, startup cost, valuation, franchise fee, inventory turnover, operating expense): https://taxease-docs.aoneahsan.com/tools/business-calculators
- Compliance tools (tax bracket, tax deadlines, mileage, home-office, charitable deduction): https://taxease-docs.aoneahsan.com/tools/compliance-tools
- Document generators (NDA, LLC operating agreement, bill of sale, invoice, receipt, employment contract, lease agreement, power of attorney, business plan, generic contract): https://taxease-docs.aoneahsan.com/tools/document-generators
